Beef, cheese and pickle sliders on soft buns.How to make it500g beef mince8 small soft slider buns8 slices of American cheese1 white onion, finely diced1/2 cup dill pickle slices3 tbsp yellow mustard3 tbsp tomato sauceRoll the mince into 8 balls and season well.Smash them flat on a very hot griddle, scatter with onion and cook 2 minutes, then flip and add cheese.Toast the buns, then add the patties, pickles, mustard and sauce.Head-popping green pea and mint soup shotsSlim Whitman pops the Martian heads. Bright green pea soup with a mint cream swirl.How to make it30g butter1 brown onion, diced750g frozen peas750ml vegetable stock1 cup mint leaves100ml pouring cream1 lemonSoften the onion in the butter.Add the peas and stock, simmer for 5 minutes, then blend with most of the mint until very smooth.Blend the rest of the mint into the cream with a squeeze of lemon.Pour the hot soup into shot glasses and swirl the mint cream on top.Dice-cut crispy potatoesPeople still want to roll them bones.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.Second CourseGalaxy Casino prime rib carveryArt Land opens the Galaxy in Vegas. Slow-roast rib of beef with jus and horseradish.How to make it2kg standing rib roast of beef2 tbsp sea salt flakes1 tbsp cracked black pepper4 garlic cloves, crushed2 tbsp rosemary leaves, chopped500ml beef stock4 tbsp horseradish cream1kg baby potatoes2 tbsp olive oilRub the beef with salt, pepper, garlic and rosemary and sit it on a rack in a roasting tin.Roast at 120°C until the centre reads 52°C for medium-rare.Toss the potatoes with oil and salt and roast them alongside for the last hour.Rest the beef, then blast it at 250°C for 10 minutes to crisp the fat.Deglaze the tin with the stock for a jus and carve at the table with horseradish.King Tut lamb with saffron rice, no porkByron works the floor dressed as King Tut. Spiced lamb shoulder, saffron rice and yoghurt.How to make it1.5kg lamb shoulder, bone in2 tsp ground cumin2 tsp ground coriander1 tsp ground cinnamon4 garlic cloves, crushed2 brown onions, sliced500ml chicken stock300g basmati rice1/4 tsp saffron threads200g Greek yoghurt1/2 cup mint leavesRub the lamb with the spices, garlic and salt.Sit it on the onions in a lidded pot, add the stock and braise at 160°C until it pulls apart.Soak the saffron in 2 tbsp hot water, then cook the rice with it in salted water.Pull the lamb, spoon over the juices and serve with the rice, yoghurt and mint.Third CourseInternational sign of the donut glazed ringsThe Martians blow up the donut shop. Warm yeast donuts in a lime-green glaze.How to make it400g plain flour7g sachet dried yeast50g caster sugar200ml warm milk1 egg50g butter, melted1 L vegetable oil, for frying200g icing sugar2 limesMix the flour, yeast, sugar, milk, egg, butter and a pinch of salt into a soft dough and knead until smooth, then prove until doubled.Roll out 1cm thick and cut rings with a large and small cutter.Fry at 170°C for about a minute a side until golden, then drain.Whisk the icing sugar with the lime zest and juice and dip the warm donuts.Fourth CourseIt's Not Unusual green apple sourTom Jones is on in the showroom.
